entities.name: Crucible of the Spirit Dragon
entities.description: Long ravine in the Qal Sisma mountains of Tarkir, sacred to the Temur, formed where Ugin fell and was encased in a hedron cocoon.

entities.name: Qal Sisma
entities.description: Mountains of Tarkir containing the Crucible.

entities.name: Ugin
entities.description: Spirit dragon planeswalker, twin of Nicol Bolas; fell on Tarkir, was encased in a cocoon and freed in 4559 AR.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: Ugin's twin brother who fought him and manipulated Sarkhan.

entities.name: Yasova Dragonclaw
entities.description: Temur khan who tried to stop Sarkhan.

entities.name: Sarkhan Vol
entities.description: Time-lost planeswalker who encased Ugin in a hedron cocoon and later reunited with him.

entities.name: Sorin Markov
entities.description: Vampire planeswalker who freed Ugin in 4559 AR.

entities.name: Narset
entities.description: Former planeswalker who led the Stormnexus Ritual rebellion.

entities.name: Stormnexus Ritual
entities.description: Rebellion ritual that summoned new spirit dragons and defeated the dragonlords.

entities.name: Eye of Ugin
entities.description: Location on Zendikar from which a hedron fragment was taken.

entities.name: Hedron
entities.description: Rune-etched structure that formed Ugin's cocoon.

events.summary: Ugin falls on Tarkir after fighting Nicol Bolas, carving the chasm of the Crucible.
events.quote: Ugin’s impact shattered the tundra, carving a massive chasm in the Qal Sisma mountains

events.summary: Sarkhan defies Yasova and uses a hedron fragment to encase Ugin in a restorative cocoon.
events.quote: Sarkhan defied Yasova’s attempt to stop him

events.summary: Sorin Markov performs a ritual that sunders the hedrons and frees Ugin in 4559 AR.
events.quote: performed a ritual that sundered the hedrons, freeing Ugin from his long slumber

events.summary: Ugin and Sarkhan reunite and discuss how Bolas manipulated Sarkhan and how he changed Tarkir's history.
The Stormnexus Ritual unleashes a dragonstorm in the Crucible; the dragonlords fall to new spirit dragons.
events.quote: The dragonlords fell, freeing Tarkir’s clans

relations.quote: his titanic battle with his twin brother, Nicol Bolas
To preserve Ugin’s life and restore Tarkir’s draconic essence
performed a ritual that sundered the hedrons, freeing Ugin from his long slumber
